package store

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Unscoped is the reachability bypass a reviewer planted to prove guard 2 was blind to it: a
// package-level variable holding a function literal, not a *ast.FuncDecl, so a guard that only
// walked file.Decls looking for FuncDecl skipped it entirely -- even though its body runs the
// exact same hand-concatenated SQL that bypassHoistedLiteral spells out as a named function.
var Unscoped = func(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, scope string) {
	verb := "select uid"
	tbl := "documents"
	pool.Exec(ctx, verb+" from "+tbl+" where scope='"+scope+"'")
}
